title: Roads handbook
passage: Report a pothole with the street name, nearest intersection and a description of the damage. Staff review pothole reports within two business days. This is a review target, not a repair deadline.

title: Roads handbook
passage: For a streetlight outage, include the nearest intersection and the pole number if visible from a safe place. Do not touch a damaged pole or exposed wire. Call emergency services for an immediate danger.

title: Waste collection guide
passage: Report missed waste collection after 6 p.m. on your scheduled collection day and within one business day. Leave the bin at the curb until staff provide instructions. This guide does not list collection schedules for individual addresses.

title: Parks service guide
passage: Report park maintenance issues with the park name and the nearest entrance or landmark. Keep away from damaged playground equipment. Staff review park maintenance reports within three business days.
